text_block_list.text: One day, I ran into Zenno Rob Roy as she was running along the riverbed.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: U-Um, calling it solo training is... well...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's done...! The "Sweet Pie Beloved by the Fairy King" from "Tales of Gourmet Heroes"!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So this is how the protagonist persuaded the Fairy King...
Hehe, I wonder what it tastes like—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's way too sweet...!!
I followed the recipe, right...?
Just how much of a sweet tooth does the Fairy King have...?!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I made a whole mountain of them thinking I'd hand them out...
Wh-What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "—And when I ate up all the sweets I made too much of, ...m-my weight..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...At this rate, I am far from being the hero of my ideals...!
No, like this, I cannot call myself a hero at all!!"

By continuing her running routine,
Zenno Rob Roy successfully lost weight.
